title: Native presentation of derived system direct image
statement: For every strict-system Operations o [def-strict-coefficient-system-operation-data] and scheme morphism f, its universal derived direct image is naturally isomorphic to native varying-ring direct image [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. The isomorphism intertwines every prescribed finite evaluation of o with native evaluation transported through the ordinary constant-ring direct model [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. This is solely a presentation comparison of derived direct images on strict systems; it involves no coefficient reduction or completed coefficient input.

source.place: First arrow of the Isomorphism paragraph; existing strict-system realization interfaces

proof.text: Use the existing normalized native direct comparison: identity on sections, ordinary adjoint uniqueness and derived right-adjoint conjugation construct the canonical isomorphism integralNativeDirectIso.
Instantiate that comparison with o.direct f and o.evaluation f. Its evaluation equation is definitionally the displayed equation after unfolding nativeProperConstantEvaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeProperDerivedPresentation (o : IntegralSystemRealization.Operations l E)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ e : IntegralSystemRealization.Operations.push l E o f ≅
        ProEtale.VaryingRing.P (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f,
      ∀ (N : coefficientSequenceDerived l E X) (n : ℕ),
        (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).map (e.hom.app N) ≫
            (nativeProperConstantEvaluation l E f n).hom.app N =
          ((o.evaluation f).evaluation n).hom.app N
